articles.title: Korean shamanism terms
articles.description: • Musok and mugyo are common names for Korean shamanism. Musok is an older term associated with shamanism as a folk tradition, while mugyo is a newer term often used in more scholarly contexts. • Mudang is the gender-neutral term for shamans. The less common "baksu" refers exclusively to male practitioners. • Mansin is a respectful term for shamans, meaning “10,000 spirits.” • Sinbyeong, or “spirit sickness” is an illness experienced by someone who is called by spirits.
